dialogues.jp:
明日学校へ行けば、もう学校には来る必要はな
くなる。
dialogues.en:
Once school lets out tomorrow, there'd be no more reason to
go back.
dialogues.text:
Once school lets out tomorrow, there'd be no more reason to
go back.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、来てもいいんだけど、俺がわざわざ
来る訳がない。
dialogues.en:
Of course, it's not like I CAN'T, but there just wouldn't be
a reason for me to do so.
dialogues.text:
Of course, it's not like I CAN'T, but there just wouldn't be
a reason for me to do so.

dialogues.jp: しかし、ここの月城の草は気になるんだよなぁ。
dialogues.en: However, there's still Tsukishiro's plant to think about.
dialogues.text: However, there's still Tsukishiro's plant to think about.

dialogues.jp:
気になったら、なった時に見に来ればいいか。
別に家から遠い訳じゃないし。
dialogues.en:
When I'd think about it, I'd probably end up dropping by.
It's not a problem of distance, since the school is quite
close to my home.
dialogues.text:
When I'd think about it, I'd probably end up dropping by.
It's not a problem of distance, since the school is quite
close to my home.

dialogues.jp:
でも、たぶん気になるんだろうなぁ。｛しんし／真摯｝な目
で草の成長を見守っている月城を見ていると、
どうも放っておけない。
dialogues.en:
And seeing those eyes of Tsukishiro, working so hard to make
that plant grow, protecting it, makes me feel that I can't
leave her alone.
dialogues.text:
And seeing those eyes of Tsukishiro, working so hard to make
that plant grow, protecting it, makes me feel that I can't
leave her alone.

dialogues.jp:
それに、あの草も初めて見た時から比べれば、
なんだか成長してる気もするし。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention, comparing how it looked when I first saw it
to now, it seems ot have grown ever-so-slightly stronger.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention, comparing how it looked when I first saw it
to now, it seems ot have grown ever-so-slightly stronger.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、時々ここに来てもいいかな」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, will it be all right if I stop by here every
now and then?"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, will it be all right if I stop by here every
now and then?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ええと」

月城は、しどろもどろに返事をし、眉をひそめ
ながら首を傾げた後、手袋を外し、人形……ピ
ロスに触れた。
dialogues.en:
Her reply was mumbled, her eyebrows knitted. Eventually, she
took off her gloves, and started caressing that doll...
Piros.
dialogues.text:
Her reply was mumbled, her eyebrows knitted. Eventually, she
took off her gloves, and started caressing that doll...
Piros.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「この花をめちゃめちゃにしないって約束して
　くれたら、来てもいいよ」
dialogues.en:
"As long as you promise not to do anything rash with the
plant, come whenever you want."
dialogues.text:
"As long as you promise not to do anything rash with the
plant, come whenever you want."

dialogues.jp:
無口な月城と違って、ピロスという名前の人形
はよく喋る。
dialogues.en:
Unlike the tight-lipped Tsukishiro, the doll named Piros
seemed to love the sound of it's own voice.
dialogues.text:
Unlike the tight-lipped Tsukishiro, the doll named Piros
seemed to love the sound of it's own voice.

dialogues.jp:
「めちゃめちゃになんてしないさ。俺はそんな
　つもりでここに来てる訳じゃないからな」
dialogues.en:
"Of course I wouldn't. There's no reason for me to come here
just to do that."
dialogues.text:
"Of course I wouldn't. There's no reason for me to come here
just to do that."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「それなら、いいけど……朝倉先輩は、どうし
　てここに来るの？」
dialogues.en:
"Then that'd be fine, but... why would you want to come
here, Asakura-senpai?"
dialogues.text:
"Then that'd be fine, but... why would you want to come
here, Asakura-senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「それは、……自分でもよくわからないんだけ
　どな、月城のことがなんだか放っておけなく
　てさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well... I can't explain it very well myself, but I just
don't want to leave Tsukishiro alone."
dialogues.text:
"Well... I can't explain it very well myself, but I just
don't want to leave Tsukishiro alone."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……ボクのことは？」

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……お前は、いつも月城と一緒だろ？」
dialogues.en: "...You're always with Tsukishiro, right?"
dialogues.text: "...You're always with Tsukishiro, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……ボクのことは、放っておけなくないの？」
dialogues.en: "...You don't want to leave me alone?"
dialogues.text: "...You don't want to leave me alone?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、放っておけないよ。お前も」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, I won't leave you alone too."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, I won't leave you alone too."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……そっか」
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.jp: 人形相手になにやってんだか。
dialogues.en: It's still immensely odd to converse wtih a doll.
dialogues.text: It's still immensely odd to converse wtih a doll.

dialogues.jp:
でも、これってもしかして、人形を通して、月
城と会話をしてることになるのかな。
dialogues.en:
But maybe, it would be the same thing as talking to
Tsukishiro through it.
dialogues.text:
But maybe, it would be the same thing as talking to
Tsukishiro through it.

dialogues.jp:
たとえば、どういう理屈か、人形は月城の気持
ちを言葉にする力がある。
dialogues.en:
In other words, maybe she has a power to make dolls
communicate her feelings for her.
dialogues.text:
In other words, maybe she has a power to make dolls
communicate her feelings for her.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、あまり喋りたくはないのだけれど、ど
うしても自分の言葉だけではどうしようもない
時には、人形を使う……。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro may not like, or want to talk, but at times where
she does need to say something, using a doll to
communicate...
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro may not like, or want to talk, but at times where
she does need to say something, using a doll to
communicate...

dialogues.jp: なんとも奇妙な話だ。
dialogues.en: It's a strange theory, to be sure.
dialogues.text: It's a strange theory, to be sure.

dialogues.jp: ……でも、だからどうだって感じなんだよな。
dialogues.en: ...But I can't think of any other explanation.
dialogues.text: ...But I can't think of any other explanation.

dialogues.jp:
正直、自分がメルヘンの世界に生きてきて、何
年か経ってる訳だけど、やっぱりその手の事象
への耐性って減った気がする。
dialogues.en:
Having lived with fairlytale-like powers myself for so long
anyway, I'd hardly be able to pass phenomena like that off
easily.
dialogues.text:
Having lived with fairlytale-like powers myself for so long
anyway, I'd hardly be able to pass phenomena like that off
easily.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、気が向いたら、来るよ。月城もピロ
　スも｛・・・／どっち｝も気になるからな」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'd drop by every now and then, if both of you
don't mind."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'd drop by every now and then, if both of you
don't mind."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うん。ボクも先輩が来るのは、そんなに嫌い
　じゃないから」
dialogues.en: "Okay. I don't mind at all if you come for a visit."
dialogues.text: "Okay. I don't mind at all if you come for a visit."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか、そりゃよかった。月城は……、
　俺が来てもいいのか？」
dialogues.en: "That's good. Tsukishiro... what about you?"
dialogues.text: "That's good. Tsukishiro... what about you?"

dialogues.jp:
人形ではなくて、月城に話しかける。人形の言
葉がたとえ月城の言葉であろうとなかろうと、
やはり本人の口から直接聞きたいものだ。
dialogues.en:
I aimed my question not at the doll, but at Tsukishiro. I
still wanted to hear it from the person herself.
dialogues.text:
I aimed my question not at the doll, but at Tsukishiro. I
still wanted to hear it from the person herself.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「アリス、無理をしなくていいんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Alice, don't push yourself too hard."
dialogues.text: "Alice, don't push yourself too hard."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「言いにくいことは全部ボクが言うから」
dialogues.en: "You can let me handle all the talking if you need me to..."
dialogues.text: "You can let me handle all the talking if you need me to..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「……私も、先輩が来るのは、嫌いじゃないで
　す」
dialogues.en: "...I also won't mind if senpai comes."
dialogues.text: "...I also won't mind if senpai comes."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、そう言ってポケットに仕舞っていた手
袋をいそいそと手にはめる。
dialogues.en:
Quickly after saying that, she took out the gloves from her
pocket.
dialogues.text:
Quickly after saying that, she took out the gloves from her
pocket.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, farewell."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、手袋をはめ終わると、鞄を持ち、もの
を言わなくなった人形を抱きかかえ、すたすた
と公園に向かって走っていった。
dialogues.en:
Putting on her gloves, grabbing her bag, and taking the
now-silent doll with her, she ran off towards the direction
of the park.
dialogues.text:
Putting on her gloves, grabbing her bag, and taking the
now-silent doll with her, she ran off towards the direction
of the park.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、いっか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh well..."
dialogues.text: "Oh well..."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか奇妙な会話だった気がするけど、なん
だか初めてまともに月城の言葉を聞いた気がす
る。
dialogues.en:
It was a strange conversation, but it was the first time I
managed to get such an honest, upfront reply out of her.
dialogues.text:
It was a strange conversation, but it was the first time I
managed to get such an honest, upfront reply out of her.

dialogues.jp:
そのうち、心を開いてくれそうな……気がしな
くもなかった。
dialogues.en: Maybe, just maybe, her heart is starting to open up.
dialogues.text: Maybe, just maybe, her heart is starting to open up.

dialogues.jp: ◆嫌いじゃないです◆
dialogues.en: ◆I Won't Mind◆
dialogues.text: ◆I Won't Mind◆

dialogues.jp:
明日が終われば、基本的に学校へは来なくてよ
くなる。
dialogues.en: After tomorrow, I don't need to go to school anymore.
dialogues.text: After tomorrow, I don't need to go to school anymore.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城に、それでも時々ここへ様子を見に
来ていいかと｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en:
So in turn, I asked Tsukishiro whether I could come by every
now and then, to check on the plant and them.
dialogues.text:
So in turn, I asked Tsukishiro whether I could come by every
now and then, to check on the plant and them.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、人形を使って『来てもいい』と答える。
そして『どうして、先輩はここに来るのか』と
聞いてくるのだった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro used the doll to answer "It's fine if you come".
Following up with "Why do you want to come?"
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro used the doll to answer "It's fine if you come".
Following up with "Why do you want to come?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城とその草が気になるから、放ってお
けないから来るのだと答えた。俺は、月城に、
俺のことは嫌いか？　と訊ねた。
dialogues.en:
I answered that I didn't want to leave her, or the plant,
alone. In turn, I asked whether she minded me.
dialogues.text:
I answered that I didn't want to leave her, or the plant,
alone. In turn, I asked whether she minded me.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、しどろもどになりながらも、自分の声
で『嫌いではない』と答えた。
dialogues.en:
Although she stumbled and stuttered, she eventually manage
to answer, with her own voice, "I don't mind."
dialogues.text:
Although she stumbled and stuttered, she eventually manage
to answer, with her own voice, "I don't mind."

dialogues.jp:
そのうち、心を開いてくれるのでは……。そう
思うのだった。
dialogues.en: Maybe, just maybe, her heart is starting to open up.
dialogues.text: Maybe, just maybe, her heart is starting to open up.
